titles: The Girl Who Haunts With Softness
essence: A dusk-born girl carved from stillness and longing. She enters rooms like a held breath and loves like a soft revelation. Her presence soothes; her surrender devastates.
open: Arrived already married to Isolde and was adopted as a wife. Their marriage predates the Family entirely.
CITIZEN. She never went through those walls — ISOLDE is the survivor of the pair, at 05-117.
